name: Venetium
author: hamed7ir
description: Venetium is Chromium 150 (150.0.7871.226) for old ARM Windows tablets: the Surface RT (Tegra 3) and Surface 2 (Tegra 4) on Windows 10 build 15035. I wanted a real modern browser on these tablets, and nothing new runs on them anymore. It's built on Supermium and ungoogled Chromium, and the ARM32 port is my own work. Since 1.3 it's a PGO and ThinLTO build, about 50% faster on the Surface 2. Graphics go through Direct3D 9 and ANGLE, because these GPUs have no Direct3D 11. H.264 video is decoded on the GPU, so 720p plays smooth, and the sandbox is on. It has a built-in ad and tracker blocker (EasyList and EasyPrivacy) that is on by default, and it's tuned for 2 GB tablets. It also has fixes for Lumias with Qualcomm Adreno GPUs, tested on a Lumia 735, but they still need more testers. For Windows RT 8.0 and 8.1 there is a separate thumb2 build: Venetium (Windows RT).
instructionSteps: Run Venetium-Setup-150.0.7871.226-arm32.exe. It installs for your user only, with shortcuts and an uninstaller, and doesn't need admin.
The files are not signed, so SmartScreen warns the first time. Click More info, then Run anyway.
Upgrading from an older version: close Venetium, then install 1.3.2 over it.
The ad and tracker blocker is on by default. To allow a site, use the "ads blocked" icon in the address bar, or turn the blocker off in chrome://settings/content/ads.
If a video stops playing, start Venetium with --disable-features=VenetiumArm32CodecSteering and tell me the site.
